info.title: Plenact User Data Model 1.0 API Contract
info.description: Final specification for iOS, Plenact.com web and Windows C#. These reserved routes are not deployed by publishing this document. Normative rules are in Specification.md, Synchronization.md and Assets.md.

servers.description: Reserved Version 1.0 endpoint namespace; distinct from the Version 0 .php shared demo.

get.summary: Read supported model versions and fixed protocol limits
get.description: Read supported model versions and fixed protocol limits. This path is reserved; no deployment is implied.

default.description: Structured failure; see status/error mapping in Synchronization.md

get.summary: Read the verified personal account record
get.description: Read the verified personal account record. Authentication/session issuance is an identity-service boundary, not a user-data mutation.

default.description: Structured failure; see status/error mapping in Synchronization.md

get.summary: Read the one personal workspace record for the authenticated account
get.description: Read the one personal workspace record for the authenticated account. The initial version exposes one workspace, not a public directory.

default.description: Structured failure; see status/error mapping in Synchronization.md

post.summary: Create a consistent 30-minute snapshot lease and return its first page, including current records and all tombstones
post.description: Create a consistent 30-minute snapshot lease and return its first page, including current records and all tombstones. Cookie clients require CSRF protection.

default.description: Structured failure; see status/error mapping in Synchronization.md

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: Required for browser-cookie sessions; native bearer callers omit it. Origin is also checked.

get.description: Continue the same frozen snapshot. Only its final page exposes a change cursor at the fence.

default.description: Structured failure; see status/error mapping in Synchronization.md

get.summary: Pull ordered revisions after an opaque cursor
get.description: Pull ordered revisions after an opaque cursor. An expired cursor requires a fresh snapshot while preserving the client outbox.

default.description: Structured failure; see status/error mapping in Synchronization.md

get.summary: Read an authorized record or tombstone
get.description: Read an authorized record or tombstone. Unknown and foreign-workspace records receive the same generic 404 response.

default.description: Structured failure; see status/error mapping in Synchronization.md

post.summary: Apply at most 100 operations atomically against expected revisions
post.description: Apply at most 100 operations atomically against expected revisions. Conflicts never partially commit. Successful receipts survive for the account lifetime.

default.description: Structured failure; see status/error mapping in Synchronization.md

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Must equal transaction_id. Retries reuse exact UTF-8 request bytes.

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: Required for browser-cookie sessions; native bearer callers omit it. Origin is also checked.

post.summary: Create a 24-hour unverified chunk staging lease for an existing described Asset revision
post.description: Create a 24-hour unverified chunk staging lease for an existing described Asset revision. Does not mark content uploaded or verified.

default.description: Structured failure; see status/error mapping in Synchronization.md

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: Required for browser-cookie sessions; native bearer callers omit it. Origin is also checked.

get.summary: Read staged chunk indexes so an interrupted upload can resume
get.description: Read staged chunk indexes so an interrupted upload can resume.

default.description: Structured failure; see status/error mapping in Synchronization.md

put.summary: Write one 256-KiB chunk, except the final shorter chunk
put.description: Write one 256-KiB chunk, except the final shorter chunk. Identical retries succeed; a different chunk at the same index conflicts.

default.description: Structured failure; see status/error mapping in Synchronization.md

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: Required for browser-cookie sessions; native bearer callers omit it. Origin is also checked.

post.summary: Verify concatenated bytes and unchanged Asset revision, atomically publish the immutable blob, increment the Asset revision and append its change
post.description: Verify concatenated bytes and unchanged Asset revision, atomically publish the immutable blob, increment the Asset revision and append its change.

default.description: Structured failure; see status/error mapping in Synchronization.md

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Must equal operation_id; identical raw request retries return the same result.

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: Required for browser-cookie sessions; native bearer callers omit it. Origin is also checked.

get.summary: Download verified authorized bytes with SHA-256 ETag and HTTP Range support
get.description: Download verified authorized bytes with SHA-256 ETag and HTTP Range support. Unavailable content is not represented by an empty successful download.

default.description: Structured failure; see status/error mapping in Synchronization.md

post.summary: Explicitly purge bytes of an already tombstoned, unreferenced asset, acknowledging that opaque history media may become unavailable
post.description: Explicitly purge bytes of an already tombstoned, unreferenced asset, acknowledging that opaque history media may become unavailable. No automatic asset garbage collection occurs.

default.description: Structured failure; see status/error mapping in Synchronization.md

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: Required for browser-cookie sessions; native bearer callers omit it. Origin is also checked.

post.summary: Require recent authentication and explicit confirmation
post.description: Require recent authentication and explicit confirmation. Deny access immediately, remove primary cloud data within 24 hours and backup copies within 30 days. Offline local copies remain user-controlled.

default.description: Structured failure; see status/error mapping in Synchronization.md

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: Required for browser-cookie sessions; native bearer callers omit it. Origin is also checked.

bearerSession.description: Opaque authenticated native session. Issuance and refresh belong to the identity service; a device ID alone grants no access.

browserSession.name: __Host-plenact_session
browserSession.description: Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Strict session; mutating cookie requests additionally require trusted Origin and a session-bound X-CSRF-Token.

asset.title: Portable asset metadata; no local paths, credentials or implicit upload endpoint

calendar_index.title: Calendar selection and cross-week checklist-link ownership

calendar_week.title: Week metadata referencing a separately defined Collection

card.title: Complete Card/Note content document, not a server revision envelope

client_capabilities.title: Client capability offer, not an endpoint
client_capabilities.description: Array order is irrelevant. No account ownership is established by this message.

collection.title: Complete Collection content document; bookmarks are separate personal selections

content_graph.title: Offline content graph fixture/export slice; not a synchronization API envelope

content_types.title: Nested portable content types; not a standalone user record

daily_plan.title: Daily intention, check-in history and evening review

periodic_review.title: Private periodic reflection with separate starting/current objectives

planning_graph.title: Calendar/planning/media metadata graph slice; not a sync request or complete backup

planning_template.title: Independent template-owned Collection and source-day mappings

planning_types.title: Planning/review nested values; not a sync record

review_rhythm.title: Shared invitation/notification intent; OS permissions and scheduling remain device local

template_library.title: Template ordering, selected default and separate bundled revision provenance
